sourceTitle: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization
author: Francesco Orabona

sourceStatementsAndDefinitions.claim: dom f={x:f(x)<+infinity}; indicator i_V is 0 on V and +infinity off V. The source permits extended-real-valued functions.
A function f:R^d->[-infinity,+infinity] is closed iff every sublevel {x:f(x)<=alpha}, alpha real, is closed.
Proper means nowhere -infinity and finite somewhere.
For proper f:R^d->(-infinity,+infinity], g in R^d is a subgradient at x when f(y)>=f(x)+<g,y-x> for every y in R^d.
f:V->R, V convex; strict inequality at nontrivial convex combinations of distinct points defines strict convexity.
psi:X->R strictly convex, differentiable on nonempty int X, X=dom psi; B_psi:X times int X->R; B(x;y)=psi(x)-psi(y)-<grad psi(y),x-y>.
Receive l_t before choosing x_t in argmin over V of l_t(x)+B(x;x_(t-1))/eta_t, then pay l_t(x_t), t=1,...,T.

psi differentiable in int X, closed, strictly convex; V subset X nonempty closed convex; x_t in int X, l_t subdifferentiable on V, eta_(t+1)<=eta_t for t=1,...,T, with Algorithm15.8 requirements inherited.

The cited theorem covers a convex DIFFERENTIABLE objective on an open set containing V. Here l_t is only subdifferentiable on V, and V need not lie inside int X. It does not literally establish a single g_t in partial l_t(x_t) satisfying the asserted inequality for all u in V.
sourceStatementsAndDefinitions.disposition: Unresolved source bridge. Do not turn the asserted conclusion into an extra public source hypothesis.
sourceStatementsAndDefinitions.possible_repairs: A separately proved nonsmooth constrained optimality bridge under exact assumptions, or a separately proved direct argmin/convex-segment one-step inequality. Neither proof is supplied here.

sourceStatementsAndDefinitions.claim: For every u in V, sum_(t=1)^T l_t(x_t)-sum_(t=1)^T l_t(u) <= max_(0<=t<=T-1) B(u;x_t)/etaT - sum_(t=1)^T B(x_t;x_(t-1))/eta_t.
If eta_t=eta for every t=1,...,T, regret <= B(u;x0)/eta - (1/eta)*sum_(t=1)^T B(x_t;x_(t-1)).
The second statement is left as an exercise.
sourceStatementsAndDefinitions.disposition: Intentional omitted proof. A constant-rate specialization of the pre-max telescoping identity and deletion of the nonpositive terminal term is a DERIVED completion, not a displayed source proof.

algorithm_requirements: Nonempty closed convex V subset X subset R^d (algorithm box prints subset sign for V versus X; theorem prints subseteq).
psi:X->R strictly convex and differentiable on int X.
x0 in int X; x0 in V is NOT stated.
At round t, l_t:R^d->(-infinity,+infinity] and V subset dom l_t.
Each x_t is selected from the displayed constrained argmin and loss is paid after receipt and update.
theorem_additions: For t=1,...,T, x_t in int X and l_t subdifferentiable on V.
standing_definitions: Definition6.4 identifies X as dom psi, with nonempty interior; strict convexity presupposes convex X.
Definition2.20 is a global subgradient on R^d, not only a support on V.
Definition2.18 properness and Definition2.16 closedness have their exact extended-real meanings.

horizon_endpoints.T: The printed source uses T rounds, etaT and a maximum over 0,...,T-1, which require a positive finite horizon for that expression. No T=0 convention is printed.
horizon_endpoints.updates: x0 is given, x1,...,xT are updates; no x_(T+1) occurs.
horizon_endpoints.terminal: -B(u;xT)/etaT appears in the proof and is discarded by nonnegativity.
horizon_endpoints.monotonicity: Statement literally includes t=T and thus eta_(T+1), although Algorithm15.8 supplies only eta1,...,etaT and proof uses only t<=T-1. Record this endpoint mismatch; do not silently claim exact textual identity after normalization.
horizon_endpoints.constant_case: eta_t=eta for t=1,...,T and eta>0 inherited. Direct constant-step specialization belongs before the maximum bound.

sourceAssumptions.sequence_semantics: Conditional regret guarantee for a supplied sequence of attained interior updates. Source does not provide a general existence/interiority theorem for all data satisfying just the algorithm Require line. Uniqueness can be derived after establishing strict convexity of the update objective, but does not imply existence.

literalSourceIndexDelta: The printed monotonicity runs through t=T and mentions eta_(T+1). Lean compares only adjacent played rates. The source is not silently corrected.
